notes.title: Overseer Update out Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Revivers, let me introduce you to the Overseer!
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=2FOkKzhCol8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is the Overseer feature?
[/h2]
Players have an inventory and can pick up items from the map, place items back onto the map, and store them inside buildings. 
They can perform various tasks such as cutting trees, planting food, and constructing buildings. 
These actions take time, similar to the in-game characters.
This feature works similarly to games like Factorio or Satisfactory but from a third-person perspective. It’s optional, and players can choose whether to enable it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/a8759e12606b3ab3cf5ac383e91d3d28562b681f.jpg[/img]

[h2]How it works
[/h2]
You can turn the feature on by clicking on the Hand icon in the bottom middle of the screen. After enabling it, you’ll see an inventory in this spot.
You can use this tool either by clicking on the Hand button in the right window or by switching your cursor to the Overseer hand by pressing the Tab key and then performing actions while hovering over objects.
Pressing keys 1-9 on an English keyboard selects slots in your inventory. 
You can delete items from your inventory by moving them into the bin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/c33342684710fcde47319cf6c52b1546e6235f41.png[/img]

[h2]Becoming a Super Mutant
[/h2]
With the Overseer feature on, you’ll become part of the mutant crew – a super mutant who can reach any spot on the map, have a larger backpack capacity, and doesn’t need to sleep or eat.
This feature is especially useful at the beginning of the game when you’re working towards automation. Once you manage job priorities for your crew, automate production lines, and construct excavators and trains, you won’t need to be as involved. 
This is an automation game, so remember that your goal is efficiency, even though it’s fun to build everything yourself. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/cf3078c60d088caca6782fec65629d1857c51c79.jpg[/img]

[h2]V 0.15.11 Patch Notes
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can select production in a factory by clicking on the name of a product instead of checking a box.
[*] Golem factory is now simplified to one production mode.
[*] Beam from the sky points to a job done by the Overseer.
[*] The Overseer can perform all the jobs a character can.
[*] All resources mined, harvested, or dug by the Overseer are directly stored in the inventory.
[*] The Overseer can take items from the ground and storage into the inventory.
[*] The Overseer can delete items from the inventory.
[*] The Overseer can produce items in factories.
[*] The Overseer can build objects.
[/list]

[b]We hope you’ll enjoy the Overseer as much as we do. Let us know in the comments or on Discord!
[/b]

notes.title: UFO Update now Live in Revive & Prosper!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Revivers![/h1]

[h3][b]This is our third big update since the launch in Early Access. Woohoo![/b][/h3]
First off, a huge thank you to everyone here for your incredible feedback and suggestions. 
You’ve really helped shape the game’s direction and mechanics, and we couldn’t have done it without your insights!

[previewyoutube=uWeckJxwRas;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Roadmap:[/h2]
[h3][olist]
[*] Early Access ✅
[*] Chemical Update ✅
[*] Golems Update ✅
[*] UFO & Concrete Update ✅
[*] Orbital Update
[*] Moon Update
[*] Mars Update & Full release
[/olist][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/1ed8abc94d41a4481042bc464ec2ec0f63543f93.jpg[/img]

[h2]We’re bringing some massive changes to the gameplay:[/h2]
[b]Martians (not the Matt Damon kind) are coming![/b] They kidnap the last cow on Earth and demand a ransom. Besides that they bring their own set of destructive monster pets and stir up the gameplay dynamics.

That's why it’s time for you to take your adventures from Earth to space. Build and launch a spaceship, and find out what happened to the cow!.

For those who prefer the serene art of base-building, you can toggle off the Martian invasion and enjoy the game at a more relaxed pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/b30fdec98ca55b82f027e0253f3cbacd838dcc41.jpg[/img]


[h2]What's new:[/h2]
[b]The Martians have landed on Earth and they’ve taken the last cow! [/b]
This kicks off your new mission: decide whether to comply with their demands and share your resources, or stand your ground and fight back. Either way, you'll need to build a spaceship to resolve the cow-nundrum.

[list]
[*] [b]New Defensive Options[/b]: If you choose the path of resistance, prepare to arm yourself with bullet turrets, pneumatic turrets, train turrets and laser cannons. 
[*] [b]Revamped UI:[/b] We've redesigned the main menu to be more user-friendly. The campaign mode has evolved into a set of tutorial puzzle maps and official play maps, making it easier to jump right into the action. Plus, the editor menu has been streamlined for better clarity. In case you're interested in designing maps, check the short video here.
[previewyoutube=jTROfqzm5EY;full][/previewyoutube]
[*] [b]Enhanced Tutorials:[/b] Our very first tutorial map has been polished and now includes a UFO encounter.
[*] [b]Flexible Gameplay:[/b] Choose between three difficulty levels and two modes—playing with or without Martians. Without Martians, the game remains as you've always known it; with Martians, prepare for raids, ransom demands, and an ecosystem filled with exotic yet deadly flora and fauna.
[*] [b]New Buildings and Technologies:[/b] Space Port for building a spaceship. Concrete Facilities that Include a plant, constructor and concrete trains. Toxic Purifiers to keep your environment clean and livable.
[*] [b]More trains:[/b] Besides concrete trains, you'll enjoy constructing trains that lay tracks and finally trains equipped with defensive turrets
[*] [b]Train Depot:[/b] For repairing and your trains
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/31a352c68769e40f0492704c05f2305c45127abe.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Enhanced Armaments:[/b] Upgraded weaponry to protect your bases from extraterrestrial threats
[*] [b]Orbital Expansion:[/b] The game now lets you fly to orbit. In the next update, you'll be able to build orbital stations, which are a step between Earth and the Moon
[/list]


[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] All official maps now support Martians and monoliths.
[*] Rebuilt the main UI: split the tutorials and official maps.
[*] UFOs crash to the ground after being shot down.
[*] Rebalanced the resources allowed as ransom.
[*] Monoliths can be shot down by laser cannons.
[*] Rebalanced the cleaning of toxins by water.
[*] Fixed the unusual appearance of toxins.
[*] Rebalanced concrete construction.
[*] Martian monoliths can't spawn flora and monsters when submerged underwater.
[*] Added new particles for spawning monsters and turrets.
[*] Monsters now bleed green when killed.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters slid instead of walking.
[*] Weather now dynamically appears on all maps.
[*] Characters no longer get stuck while transporting resources.
[*] Fixed game crashes related to the new trains.
[*] Dead plants turning into biomass are now a resource and don’t need to be harvested.
[*] Fixed the issue of infinite tree cutting.
[*] Fixed trees remaining on the ground after being cut.
[*] Improved monsters' navigation.
[*] Rebalanced the time required to build the spaceport.
[*] Fixed unrepairable buildings.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/f59e8ca2070ee12fb4849eca58fab466966ff9c4.jpg[/img]

We're really excited to see how these updates will enhance your gaming experience and we're eager to hear your feedback. As always, write a comment here or reach out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/GXAM8fzsu5]Discord[/url].

notes.title: GOLEMS Update out now!

notes.title: Chemical Age update out now!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Revivers![/h1]

[h2]Check out what's waiting for you in the latest update.[/h2]

This is a Major update that we have been working on since last month. 
The Chemical Age brings new buildings into the game and changes certain existing ones to make the game more fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/0e6721ead3b7470de4c0686ab333b776f6fa7a7d.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Buildings[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Oil Pumpjack
[*] Petroleum Refinery
[*] Chemical Plant
[*] Bioethanol Plant
[*] Sealed Liquid Container
[*] Battery 
[/list]


[h3][b]New Resources[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Petroleum
[*] Alcohol
[*] Ethylene
[*] Sulphur
[*] Phosphoric Acid
[*] Fiberglass
[*] Circuit board
[*] Water with Fertilizers
[*] Polymers
[*] Plastic
[*] Cables
[*] Control Unit
[/list]

[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Water Containers - added leaking
[*] Barrels are now created from Metal Sheets not Planks and have new visual
[*] Barrel Filler & Barrel Dispenser are now glass/metallic
[/list]

[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Access all buildings from the build menu on each map
[*] Rebalanced Teleporters
[*] Wildfires from lighting have limitation to 150 trees and then they stop to spread
[*] Sprinklers speed can be customized
[*] Buildings can be destroyed on hard difficulty
[*] Fully localized tutorial
[/list]

[h3][b]Petroleum[/b][/h3]
The key resource for the Chemical Age is Petroleum. 
It’s a resource hidden under the ground on the lowest level of the map. 
You can see a Petroleum mark on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/69824875169fc34ca3bc5b6cecde751417ce1953.jpg[/img]

It can sometimes be hard to spot it in complex terrain. 
Therefore we suggest hiding all layers of the ground (by pressing key 1 or pressing the Glass Magnifier Icon at the bottom right and using Alt+Mouse Wheel Roll Up to “scroll”) and making the water transparent using the water icon at bottom right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/9c050a919e99750acdf395914977d91daea8928c.jpg[/img]

In this mode you can easily spot the Petroleum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/ef84dd8d95a5c292c005abcf29f165ddc134e56a.jpg[/img]

You can switch back by pressing 0 or the Glass Magnifier icon.

Once you discover the Petrol you need to dig the terrain to get access to it. 
For that purpose it’s ideal to use a Deep Spiral Digger. 
Just place its digging spiral on top of the stain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/c920433f5156b8f9f5d07e391166cd37630ced69.jpg[/img]

It will dig terrain quite fast. 
We do suggest using the metal belt, as the wooden belt is not fast enough. 
Once you see the digger is moving slower, or that it sometimes produces Uranium (that’s for later game) you’ve reached the bottom of the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/63cda9d01afdecb2b75dc0f7c650f451f86a4e65.jpg[/img]

Destroy the digger and now you can place an Oil Pumpjack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/1f71bc6bbcc2048d77d358ea56dae1edf5f0b1d5.jpg[/img]

Mined Petroleum should be taken into the Petroleum Refinery. 
That’s currently the biggest building in the game, with its majestic dimensions of 6x6x7 fields. 
It takes a lot of resources to build, but you typically need only one building like that in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/437f604b298098d9cf3e7146a65ce0d14c65b792.jpg[/img]

[b]At the refinery, you have two production options:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sulphur & Polymers
[*] Or Sulphur, Polymers, Ethylene & Engine Oil in Barrels.
[/list]

[h3][b]What's the use[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sulphur is used for Phosphoric Acid and Batteries
[*] Polymers are used for Plastic and Fiberglass
[*] Ethylene can be converted to Alcohol
[*] Oil is used to make machines with metal mechanisms work faster
[*] Phosphoric Acid is used for conversion of Ethylene to Alcohol and to create Water with Fertilizers
[*] Alcohol is used for Fiberglass and as fuel in Bioethanol Factories
[*] Plastic is used for Batteries, Cables & Control Units
[*] Fiberglass is used for Circuit Boards (and will be used for construction)
[*] Circuit Boards are used for Control Units, which are already the first product for the Electronics Age that is coming
[/list]
Most of the production of the Chemical Age is done in a Chemical Plant.

[h3][b]Chemical Plant[/b][/h3]
This is a special building because until now almost all production could be done manually or in an automated factory (except furnaces products). 
Same as a Refinery, it’s powered by electricity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/4a8c754b58db5430aad34426e36ad8d05caffd59.jpg[/img]

Unfortunately production in chemical plants creates toxicity in the soil. 
Over time the toxicity in the ground will grow, and if your chemical plant is built close to a water stream it can make the stream toxic, which could be disastrous.

Fortunately, bricks prevent the spread of toxicity, making it desirable to build leaky factories on top of brick dams. 
Rivers can be protected the same way.

[h3][b]Toxicity System[/b][/h3]
The toxicity system has been rebuilt. 
Toxicity prefers to stay on the surface, and if there is a water stream it’s more likely it will toxify the water. 
Water will clean toxicity from the map over time. It's a completely new viewpoint on the whole mechanic, and we hope to get your feedback in order to update the balancing.

[h3][b]BioEthanol Plant[/b][/h3]
Good news is that Alcohol is a clean and stable source of electricity if produced from Corn. 
You can create Alcohol from the chemical process of combining Ethylene, Phosphoric Acid & Water, but that’s not really cost-effective for a power source.

[h3][b]Liquids & Barrels[/b][/h3]
As you can see we added multiple liquids. 
Currently there are eight (8). 
Each liquid can be put into a barrel or released from a barrel back to pipes/storages. 
Barrels can be transported through catapults and can be destroyed with their liquid in an Incinerator - which is a method to get rid of toxicity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/13f13b270f4efd9ae74efbb5d079f3e3395bebc1.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Containers Leaking[/b][/h3]
With the new glass/metal container comes new mechanics of liquid leaking. Existing wooden containers will leak the liquid inside them, and if it’s something other than water it would create toxicity in the ground:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/f594b5de1ea43293c92d68c90a039f6697c43f6b.jpg[/img]

We strongly suggest using Sealed containers for liquids other than water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/1144424b14bfe23cef813b26ebaa52973ead8a0e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/2f08c003d79f67970567443c0e2a299e9b1eab9f.jpg[/img]

Hope you'll have fun with the new factories, plants, resources and spreading toxicity!

Let us know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/ab252c874810b29c7b4dfbe0f71c3c2d4042ede2.png[/img]

Cheers!
team R&P

notes.title: Update 0.10.23
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Revivers,[/h1]

this update brings you upgraded driller, balances on progressing through ages and fixes of bugs you've reported to us. 

Thank you for your help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/3dfa598883bfdc2b0977384deec35bdcf7f9efb0.png[/img]

[h2]MAJOR CHANGES[/h2]
[b]Revised Iron Age: Unlock Additional Structures[/b]

In the restructured Iron Age, more buildings become available once you create iron. This adjustment is due to the fact that the Metal Mechanism now necessitates iron rather than steel. However, the Metal Sheet now demands steel instead of iron.

[b]Introducing the New Steel Mining Machine: Dig Faster and Reach 9 Fields Below[/b]

A cutting-edge addition to the era is the new Steel Mining Machine, designed to excavate at an accelerated pace. This advanced device can dig down to a depth of 9 fields, providing enhanced efficiency in resource extraction.

[b]Enhanced Iron Storage: Double the Capacity of Wooden Storage[/b]

Upgrade your storage capabilities with the introduction of the new Iron Storage facility. This innovative structure doubles the capacity of the conventional wooden storage, ensuring you can amass greater quantities of resources during the Iron Age.

[h2]FIXES[/h2]

[b]Revamped Toxic Mechanism: Controlled Spread and Water Stream Cleanup[/b]

Our toxic mechanism has undergone a significant overhaul. The toxic substance no longer spreads endlessly throughout the level; instead, it can be efficiently cleansed by the water stream. We consider this update to be near its final form as a mechanic.

[b]Minor Tutorial Enhancements[/b]

In addition to the major changes, we've implemented some minor updates to enhance the tutorial experience.

This release includes several minor fixes to improve overall stability and address minor issues.

Happy holidays!
team Revive & Prosper

notes.title: Big Demo Update! Improved Map Editor, New Game Elements, and a Bunch of Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey, Revivers!

We’re super excited to let you know that we just released one of our major updates for the game demo!

[previewyoutube=twU2fRS9FV4;full][/previewyoutube]


We’re thrilled to announce that we have gone ahead and improved our Map Editor for your amazing maps. This means that the map editor can simply be unlocked by signing up or logging into the game using your email and username. [i]We’re using this method to keep the game a safe place with quality content. Your emails will remain with us only.[/i]

In addition to that, we went ahead and added [b]new resources in the game[/b], along with a [b]sedimentation[/b] machine. 

The sedimentation machine will help the characters to produce [i][b]new resources[/b][/i] like Iron and Copper Ores, along with Clay, Sand, and Silicone, which will take your gameplay to the next level! Now, no resource scarcity will stop you from expanding your empire!

Also, good news to all those [i]graphic card owners[/i] out there!! You can now play Revive & Prosper even with your GPU! We have added GPU support - GeForce GTX 750 Ti ( Thank you, [b]MrHungryFrizzyLight[/b], for testing)


In addition to that, we have [i][b]fixed a couple of annoying bugs[/b][/i], including one of the most annoying of all, which is the game-freezing issue. Thanks to vigilant players like[b] heyjude42, Gordon Katoska, Vilgot, and Szara[/b] for reporting and helping us to smooth the game experience for you all!

notes.title: Revive & Prosper🌱Huge Update
notes.notes:
Hey Revivers🌱
Here’s a huge update about new factories, end teleport and fully decomposable humanoid helpers. 
First, please watch the new trailer video to see the amazing progress our Mystiqular dev team has made.

[previewyoutube=HURWKfPs-5U;full][/previewyoutube]

The first huge upgrade is the visuals. Trees look amazingly realistic, even though they are made of a couple of hundred polygons. The plants, such as coffee, are precisely shaped and detailed. 

Besides the upgraded visuals plants now show two states – the first is growing, and the second is seeding with flowering blooms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/24d4ed0119dc27bb12d70a7ca198b0e1be71f570.png[/img]

Seeds are now necessary for planting. You pick up seeds and only then are you able to grow new plants and harvest them in the right time before they start seeding. Plus there's an interesting new plant, rice, that grows only in water. You can see the Boar planting it in the video. 

Speaking of water, there's a brand new power source – Water Wheels. Water wheels are more than twice as powerful as a windmill, and keep going even if the wind isn't blowing. Watch the water flow and adjust each wind mill's strength during drought using floodgates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/608ed5532670a694008457e0133e708c823f1eda.png[/img]

During drought, not only does water disappear through evaporation but also the wind stops blowing completely. Which means the windmills stop spinning and supplying energy to factories. From where will you get energy? 

Here comes a water wheel to save the day! 

Check the video to see how it works. 

[previewyoutube=V1mKlCcIX0I;full][/previewyoutube]

Next let me present to you all the new factories and objects in the game. The most amazing one is the golem factory, where each character can build their own golem who helps them with work. Golems don’t need to sleep or drink, they avoid water. Interesting thing is the golem can exist for two days only and then they decompose. After this happens, the character can make a new one. When the golem works, the character who makes them becomes more hungry. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/b6ef291c32e5dd95fdbfc14672d4ce367cf39388.png[/img]

For cooking characters can use the fireplace. They can make tea and coffee, cook vegetables and fish.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/b27518ce5a4d22af7f966e59707f2f6510eaccea.png[/img]

Where do they get fish, you ask? Good question. There is a special fishing place where you can catch them. 

Last but not least is news about the editor and game maps. You can play either official in-game maps, or you can build your own ones in the editor. Besides sculpting mountains and valleys with rivers, you place a starting point where you set a number of characters that will spawn on the map, along with an ending portal with a goal set for the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574998/8d5dedc838891dd7751ca678a22a4f5ea458615c.png[/img]

In one of the last articles I promised to tell you how you can protect factories from being destroyed by water and rain. Here we go. The secret lies in … roofs! I’ll tell you more about them in one of the upcoming updates. 

Cheers!
